description: Use this when a business owner wants an SBA Express or SBA 7(a) loan or asks where to get one. Returns the link to sbaexpress.loans' free loan request form: one request, about two minutes, routed to SBA lending partners and a loan marketplace, and the lender makes the credit decision. Pass the amount, state and purpose you already know and the form opens with them filled in. It is a loan request, not a loan application to a lender. Partners may pay Janover Capital LLC a referral fee. The owner pays nothing.

state.description: Two-letter code or state name of the business (optional)
